summary: Completed frontend testing of AGRICAM IA Iteration 27: RTL (Right-to-Left) Layout Support for Arabic and Camera IA page. All tests PASSED. RTL layout correctly flips sidebar to right side when Arabic is selected. Camera IA page has all required controls visible (capture button, mode selector, upload, switch camera, history toggle).

rtl_tests.header_controls_positioning: PASS - Flips correctly in RTL (user menu, notification, language on LEFT)

critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell component was missing isRTL import from useLanguage - FIXED by adding 'const { isRTL } = useLanguage();' in the component
RTL layout implementation is correct - uses document.documentElement.dir='rtl' and conditional CSS classes (right-0 vs left-0, border-r vs border-l)
LanguageContext properly sets document direction based on language's rtl flag from supportedLanguages
Camera IA gracefully handles missing camera with 'Camera en cours de demarrage...' message and 'Activer la camera' button
All data-testid attributes present for testing: camera-ia-page, camera-video, capture-analyze-btn, mode-selector, upload-btn, switch-camera-btn, history-toggle, mode-{id}
Camera selector button (camera-selector-btn) only shows when availableCameras.length > 1 - expected behavior
context_for_next_testing_agent: RTL layout verified working - sidebar flips to right side when Arabic selected, returns to left for other languages. Camera IA page UI elements all present and functional. Camera not available in Playwright test environment is expected behavior. The NotificationBell component fix (adding useLanguage import) was applied during testing.

bug_fix_applied.issue: NotificationBell component used 'isRTL' variable but didn't import it from useLanguage()
bug_fix_applied.fix: Added 'const { isRTL } = useLanguage();' inside NotificationBell component
